description: We are StarChase, a team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our project, "Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map," aims to explore Mars through interactive mapping and creative problem-solving. We are passionate about space exploration, planetary science, technology, and innovation. We welcome curious and creative minds who enjoy collaboration and tackling challenges. We are especially interested in connecting with people skilled in Coding, data visualization,  and design.
